Due to airspace restrictions, a direct flight corridor between Hub Alpha and Hub Beta is unavailable.  
Furthermore, operational regulations mandate that exactly one of the following two flight segments must be incorporated into the itinerary: the segment connecting Hub Beta and Hub Gamma, or the segment connecting Hub Gamma and Hub Delta.  

The objective is to determine the most fuel-efficient cyclic route that visits every hub exactly once and returns to the initial hub.
